title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. This note reports the live paper record as it stands at 2026-11-20T03:25:56.060Z, with no projection. Every position discussed here is paper, and a single trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Framing and scope
trend-daily-v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and trend-daily-v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The framing is paper signals only, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That statement describes the tested distribution; it is not a forecast for this live record, and it does not turn the current losses into a prediction. The live starts are engine-specific, so the amount of live history differs by engine. That difference is part of the record and is not adjusted or projected here.

## Open positions and recent closed trades
htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper and 5 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper, 6 closed trades so far, and average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper, 7 closed trades so far, and average -13.34% net per trade. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. These entries and exits are recorded outcomes and one open position, not an assessment of either engine. The trend engines show negative average net across their small closed samples, and small samples are not enough to judge either engine.

## Market filter and breakout distances
trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both engines show 0 positions open on paper. The filter state is reported as it stands; with no positions open for either engine, the record shows no held trend positions. Because the filter is off, the record does not show open positions for either trend engine at this snapshot. The breakout distances are the nearest listed symbols, not a queue of pending trades. The closest symbols to a 20-day breakout are:
- trend-daily-v005: TRXUSDT is 5.13% below its high; THETAUSDT is 18.09% below its high; ATOMUSDT is 18.62% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006: TRXUSDT is 5.13% below its high; JUPUSDT is 6.22% below its high; THETAUSDT is 18.09% below its high.
These percentages measure distance from each symbol's high under the engine's breakout rule. They are descriptive record fields, not entry signals, targets, or expected moves.

## Reading the record
The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the state described here is a snapshot read at 2026-11-20T03:25:56.060Z. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single closed trade, including the ATOM exit at -17.9%, does not establish whether a strategy works. The performance page, signal log, and channel status are the same record in different views; checking them against each other is a way to verify the figures, not a way to forecast them. The record is reported as it stands, without projection, and without advice about any coin or trade.
